in_sanskrit.name: हीमप्रिया
in_sanskrit.meaning: हीम (Hima) - Snow प्रिय (Priya) - Dear Therefore, HimaPriya means 'Snow-dear' or 'Snow-beloved'

in_marathi.name: Himapriyaa
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Loved by God Hima
in_marathi.long_meaning: Himapriyaa हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Hima is a goddess of the earth, and Priyaa means 'loved'. This name signifies being cherished and protected by the divine earth goddess.
